beats.event: Age 16 with terminal thyroid cancer; forced into support group
Meets Augustus Waters, in remission from osteosarcoma
They bond instantly and swap favorite novels
Frustrated her favorite novel ends mid-sentence
Augustus arranges correspondence with author van Houten
Uses Genie Foundation wish for Amsterdam trip together
In Amsterdam van Houten proves a mean-spirited drunk
Lidewij takes them to Anne Frank House; first kiss there
That evening they become intimate and confess love
Augustus reveals his cancer has returned
He organizes a 'pre-funeral' where friends eulogize him
Van Houten shows up at funeral to apologize
She reads the eulogy Augustus secretly wrote for her
Hazel is satisfied with the choices she made
